Population increased in Greater Manchester (county)

The estimated population of Greater Manchester (county) in 2024 was 3,009,664 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Greater Manchester (county) increased by 4.9%.

Age profile of Greater Manchester (county)

The average (median) age fell to 36.9 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Greater Manchester (county) has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, Greater Manchester (county)'s population of 3,009,664 usual residents was made up of:

  • 606,958 people aged 0 to 15 years, (20.2%)
  • 1,931,274 people aged 16 to 64 years, (64.2%)
  • 471,432 people aged 65 years and over, (15.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Greater Manchester (county) has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (15.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Greater Manchester (county), the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Greater Manchester (county)
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Greater Manchester (county), between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 6,465 people (0.2%). In total, there were 32,308 births and 25,843 deaths in Greater Manchester (county).
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 5,547 (-0.2%). There were 104,108 people entering the area and 109,655 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Greater Manchester (county)'s population of 43,116 (1.5%) as a result of 62,844 people entering the area and 19,728 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Greater Manchester (county) was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Greater Manchester (county) in mid-2023 is 2,965,612.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 14,414 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 2,565 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 16,979 people.
